notes: CONSERVATIVE PLACEHOLDERS, NOT MEASURED. Plan P7 ships these so the gate is auditable from the first commit; P9 grid-searches them on the dev split and rewrites this file with calibrated=true plus the dataset size and class balance. min_dense sits above the measured similarity of irrelevant pairs; min_coverage_high is higher than min_coverage so the lexical branch is the stricter of the two. Thresholds are keyed on model_id and a mismatched file is refused, never reused.
